reason: Feb 28, 2027 is the end of the annual allowance period, not a sunset of the law: end_date set to null and the period moved into key_value (rule 1). The document does not name S.F. Admin. Code ch. 37, so the citation now uses the Rent Board announcement the document gives (rule 5).

rule.title: San Francisco annual allowable rent increase (3/1/2026-2/28/2027)
rule.citation: San Francisco Rent Board, Annual Rent Increase for 3/1/26 - 2/28/27
rule.requirement: For rent-controlled units in San Francisco, the most your landlord can raise your rent for the yearly increase from March 1, 2026 to February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rule.requirement_es: Para unidades con control de renta en San Francisco, lo máximo que el propietario puede subir la renta en el aumento anual del 1 de marzo de 2026 al 28 de febrero de 2027 es 1.6%.

applies_if.value_text: unit is rent-controlled under the San Francisco Rent Ordinance

rule.quote: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
